summary.name: Jet New
summary.one_liner: Personal website of Jet New, with notes on thinking, learning, and an AI tool called Atlas that he is building.
use_cases: read founder's notes on thinking and learning
find the Atlas AI tool project
explore ideas about tools for thought
learn about living documents and evergreen writing
summary.what_it_does: The page is the personal homepage of Jet New, described as notes on what he is thinking about, learning, and working on. It states he is building Atlas, an AI tool for thought. It links to a 2019 essay by Andy Matuschak and Michael Nielsen on tools that expand what people can think. It also states that his writing consists of living documents, with a link to a Wikipedia definition of that term. The page text gives no further details about Atlas's features.
notable: Building Atlas, an AI tool for thought
Writing treated as living, continually updated documents
Links to Matuschak and Nielsen's essay on tools for thought
caveats: Atlas is described only as in progress; no release status, features or pricing are given on the page
